flags.issue: Treated final valuation date as callable ('any quarterly Observation Date, beginning on July 29, 2027'; Example 2 refers to the Fortieth/Final date as 'NOT automatically called'). 37 levels for obs 4..40. Economically equivalent at maturity since call level 100 >= downside threshold, but verify count convention.
Names written as in cleaned text with spaced '®' ('Russell 2000 ® Index'); cleaning split ® onto separate lines in prose.
Filing uses 'Settlement Date' (July 31, 2026); taken as issue date.
First three observation/payment rows carry '*' (non-callable footnote); dates subject to postponement, scheduled dates used.

scope.reason: Worst-of contingent-coupon autocallable on two equity price-return indices (RTY, SX5E); non-memory quarterly coupon; European (final-date-only) downside threshold with 1:1 loss; discrete quarterly autocall from obs 4. No buffer, no daily monitoring.
